title: Real parent-child chunk write + recall (F4/F9)
implemented: openviking/indexing/plan.py: IndexPlan gains parent_token_budget (default 0) carried from chunking.parent_max_tokens; build_plan sets it on every plan.
openviking/indexing/plan.py: IndexPlan.validate_parent_budget(count) rejects any parent context exceeding the declared recall budget (no silent truncation).
openviking/indexing/plan.py: chunk_fields now emits explicit source_uri == the ORIGINAL plan URI, alongside chunk_id/parent_chunk_id; no position/span/offset/hash fields are added.
openviking/indexing/plan.py: children_by_parent(chunks) groups many children under one parent identity.

openviking/indexing/plan.py: expand_parent_budget(candidates, budget_tokens, count) attaches parent context in rank order within a token budget, dropping only parent_text (never the child hit) once exhausted; budget<=0 disables expansion.
verified_contracts: One parent with multiple children yields DISTINCT primary keys via vector_record_id_for_data (account_id, uri, chunk_id, generation).
Head/mid/tail facts are all present in stored chunk_text; every stored record uri and source_uri equals the original Viking URI.
A distant tail hit sharing a URI with a head hit is NOT dropped: aggregate_by_uri keeps both matches[] and group source_uri is the original URI.
Parent expansion stays within the token budget while all child hits survive.
Superseded generation is excluded by PublicationStore.visibility while the retired build stays 'published'.
D2 path: reindexing existing Markdown builds the text plan from the original bytes only; zero ParserRouter.parse calls, zero write_file calls, and read URIs are exactly {original URI} (no _toc.json).
not_run: Real vector backend end-to-end: no live VikingDB/Qdrant/cuvs write, ANN search, or top-k recall of the head/mid/tail gold facts. Tests use the shared IndexPlan, deterministic record-id derivation, PublicationStore (real SQLite), the embedding worker handler with a fixture Database, and the pure fusion primitives.
No production collection schema migration was exercised (source_uri is dropped by adapters that filter to known fields; it is informational for consumers that read chunk_fields directly).
BM25/lexical recall of the same gold facts and cross-space fusion are out of scope (KB-016/KB-017).
No real embedding model or tokenizer beyond the fixture BPE tokenizer; no measured recall/NDCG quality numbers.
Chunk-level parent expansion inside the live hierarchical retriever path is not wired to expand_parent_budget in this task (pure helper only).
